description: Core-seeded structural predicate helpers anchored on std/core.mm safety atoms. The generated module must remain in the Z3-decidable fragment and avoid Lean escalation.
implementation_notes: Each atom has an explicit body so deterministic forge rendering never needs an LLM credential.
Use only linear integer constraints and 0/1 witnesses.
Anchor the contracts on std/core.mm concepts such as safe_to_index and is_nonzero without importing new trusted atoms.

atoms.name: safe_index_or_zero
atoms.description: Return idx when it is inside an inclusive non-negative bound, otherwise 0.
atoms.body: if idx >= 0 { if idx <= len { idx } else { 0 } } else { 0 }

atoms.name: is_nonzero_flag
atoms.description: Return a 0/1 witness for nonzero scalar values.

atoms.name: preserve_safe_index
atoms.description: Expose an already-safe index unchanged while preserving its bound evidence.
